searchText: What does everybody think about aligning the metrics produced by the different beacon chain and validators to the same standard so as to help different client adoptions I think that’s a big hinderence in seamlessly moving between clients (besides the lack of Interop slashing protection database migration yet) Since one has all their monitoring and stats based on one client. Then you try to move to another client and you’re basically flying blind All over again
